name: oyren-agent
description: The sandbox agent behind VS Code's built-in Chat view — one participant for all seven providers.
_comment.enabledApiProposals: isDefault + modes on the participant and isUserSelectable on the provider's models need these
proposals at 1.109. They are matched against the launcher's --enable-proposed-api
oyren.oyren-agent (see deploy/sandbox-host/start-editor.mjs). Do NOT move this list into
product.json's extensionEnabledApiProposals: that key OVERRIDES an extension's own declaration

chatParticipants.name: oyren
_comment.modes: ALL THREE, not just ask. The panel opens in Agent mode (hardcoded default, chatInputPart
~:508), and getDefaultAgent filters by mode — an ask-only default participant makes every
Agent- and Edit-mode send die in a swallowed 'Cannot handle request' with no UI at all.
Core wraps nothing loop-shaped around an agent-mode participant at 1.109: it invokes the
handler once and tool orchestration is the participant's own business — which ours does
engine-side. So claiming all modes is honest, and the only alternative is silence.
